purpose: Teach: 慰霊/機関車/時効/パトカー/系譜/恐慌/靖国神社/内蔵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦争、本気で、絶対、慰霊、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on war memorials was genuinely impressive. Your research depth really stood out.
lines.style: Warm, measured professional tone. Gentle opening with the student's name. Genuine praise delivered without excess—steady eye contact, unhurried pace. A teacher recognizing real work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。明治時代の、本気で、絶対、機関車、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you, sensei. I really threw myself into researching the Meiji-era locomotive systems. I'm grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine gratitude, not performative. Clear voice, direct but not stiff. Quiet pride in the work itself. The warmth of someone who respects the person listening.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 刑法の、本気で、絶対、時効、絶対、制度、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And your handling of criminal law statutes of limitation—the breadth of your perspective was remarkable. Truly impressive work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly leaning back. Reflective cadence, like she's turning the work over in her mind as she speaks. Warm observation, not lecturing. Genuine recognition of intellectual maturity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。警察の、本気で、絶対、パトカー、絶対、配備、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I spent a lot of time researching police deployment patterns and patrol car systems. I'm really grateful for your support throughout this.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Measured pace showing care in the words. Quiet confidence in what she did. Not over-explaining—just letting the gratitude land simply and genuinely.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 各家系の、本気で、絶対、系譜、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your exploration of family genealogy and lineage systems showed real maturity. That's the kind of thinking we need more of.
lines.style: Engaged and present. Slight nod in the voice. Recognition mixed with gentle encouragement. The tone of a teacher who sees a student's actual capability emerging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。世界、本気で、絶対、恐慌、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really immersed myself in studying global economic history and the Depression era. I appreciate everything you've taught me.
lines.style: Sincere and grounded. Voice steady, not rushed. The kind of thank-you that feels like it cost something to say well. Genuine deference without diminishing herself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、靖国神社、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your work on Yasukuni Shrine history was handled with real insight. I was genuinely moved by the depth of your research.
lines.style: Reflective and careful, like speaking about something that matters. Slower pace. Genuine admiration underneath. The respect of one person for another's serious thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。日本の、本気で、絶対、内蔵、絶対、技術、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I put real care into researching the history of Japanese industrial technology. I truly appreciate your mentorship.
lines.style: Warm closing gratitude. Voice softens slightly, sincere without becoming fragile. The relief and satisfaction of finishing something hard together. Final words trail with quiet appreciation.
